title: Precast Cladding (Thorp)
status: Draft spot check from ITPs – for agreement

questions.q: Visual sample / mock-up accepted for this finish?
Unit carries its panel reference and has no damage; brick inserts unchipped and pointed?
Ask the fitter: What joint width and sealant depth are you working to? Could they answer?
questions.source: SuperPrime site practice – a fitter who can't answer is a red flag

questions.q: Fixings fully fixed, shims within the drawing limit, torque marks on nuts?
Joint widths even (GRC max 10 mm), panels aligned with neighbours?
Joints sealed with backer rod and sealant, neatly and continuously?
Anchor load tests done before panels are hung?
Water/hose test done at the agreed locations before internal finishes?
Cavity barriers and insulation behind the panels complete as the benchmark?
Main contractor items (cast-in channels, setting-out) in tolerance before panels are hung?
Panels checked on unloading – no chips, cracks or damage?

notOk.t: Chips, cracks and stains to stone, brick and GRC
VCL / insulation damaged or not taped
GRC joints over 10 mm / panels not aligned
Visible repairs not matching the original
